title: Plugin identity setup
description: Questions npm run setup asks in a terminal. Field ids are the --answers keys and option names; scripts/setup/form.mjs reads only text and confirm fields. Enter keeps the current value, which setup validates and reviews before writing. An azure-devops hosting answer is followed by the Azure DevOps details from scripts/setup/hosting.mjs.

fields.label: Plugin ID
fields.help: Portable plugin id: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (at most 64 characters).

fields.label: Plugin name
fields.help: Display name shown in the host, at most 80 characters.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: One-line plugin description, at most 300 characters.

fields.label: GitHub repository
fields.help: Optional owner/name, without a URL, .git suffix or credentials.

fields.label: Enable project-local Workbench MCP for Claude Code and Codex?
fields.help: Writes repository-local client settings only; installs no client. Not asked when --mcp, --no-mcp or an mcp answer was supplied.

fields.label: Hosting platform: github, azure-devops or none
fields.help: Where pull requests and CI live. Enter keeps the current platform (GitHub when none was recorded); azure-devops then asks for the organization, project and repository, suggested from an Azure DevOps origin remote. Setup prepares files and package metadata only: it never runs gh or az, adds a remote or stores a token. Not asked when --hosting, an --azure-* option or a hosting answer was supplied.
